'''Polar Trench 12''' was a trench on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was located within [[D-Quadrant]]. It was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] along with the rest of the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
